mr2.renameWhileRunning.en: You can rename this launch once it finishes launching.
mr2.renameWhileRunning.zh: 投放创建完成后即可重命名。

mr2.state.createdPaused.meta.zh: 已在 Meta 创建，处于暂停状态

mr2.state.createdPaused.tiktok.zh: 已在 TikTok 创建，处于暂停状态

mr2.switchPending.en: Waiting for the first read of this campaign's switch.
mr2.switchPending.zh: 正在等待第一次读取该活动的开关状态。

mr2.hint.meta.devMode.en: Your Meta app is in Development mode, so Meta will not build ads from it yet. That clears when business verification passes and you press Publish in the App Dashboard; then press Retry here.
mr2.hint.meta.devMode.zh: 你的 Meta 应用仍处于开发模式，Meta 暂不允许它创建广告。待商家验证通过并在应用面板中点击“发布”后，再在此处点击“重试”。

mr2.hint.meta.appPermission.en: The app is not allowed to manage this ad account. Check the app's Marketing API access and that it is attached to the business.
mr2.hint.meta.appPermission.zh: 该应用无权管理这个广告账户。检查应用的 Marketing API 权限，以及它是否已关联到该商务管理平台。

mr2.hint.meta.token.en: The Meta access token has expired or was revoked. Generate a new one and update the server.
mr2.hint.meta.token.zh: Meta 访问令牌已过期或被撤销。重新生成一个并更新到服务器。

mr2.hint.meta.policyBlock.en: Meta has temporarily blocked this account over a policy issue. Open Account Quality in Business Manager, clear the notice, then press Retry.
mr2.hint.meta.policyBlock.zh: Meta 因政策问题暂时限制了该账户。在商务管理平台打开「账户质量」，处理其中的提示后再点击重试。

mr2.hint.meta.funding.en: This ad account has no working payment method. Add one in Ads Manager, then press Retry.
mr2.hint.meta.funding.zh: 该广告账户没有可用的支付方式。在广告管理工具中添加一个，然后点击重试。

mr2.hint.meta.spendLimit.en: This ad account has reached its spending limit. Raise or reset it in Ads Manager, then press Retry.
mr2.hint.meta.spendLimit.zh: 该广告账户已达到消费上限。在广告管理工具中调高或重置后再点击重试。

mr2.hint.meta.accountDisabled.en: Meta has disabled this ad account. It cannot run ads until Meta reinstates it; launch on another assigned account.
mr2.hint.meta.accountDisabled.zh: Meta 已停用该广告账户。在 Meta 恢复之前无法投放，请改用另一个已分配的账户。

mr2.hint.meta.adAccount.en: Meta refused this ad account. Open it in Ads Manager, clear the notice shown there, then press Retry.
mr2.hint.meta.adAccount.zh: Meta 拒绝了这个广告账户。在广告管理工具中打开该账户，处理其中的提示后再点击重试。

mr2.hint.meta.transient.en: Meta was busy or rate-limited this request. Wait a few minutes, then press Retry.
mr2.hint.meta.transient.zh: Meta 当时繁忙或触发了频率限制。等几分钟后再点击重试。

mr2.waitingLine.en: Meta is still processing the uploaded clip. Studio checks again in about a minute; nothing is re-uploaded.
mr2.waitingLine.zh: Meta 仍在处理上传的切片。Studio 约一分钟后会再次检查，不会重复上传。
